instructions: Speak like a warm, calm exercise coach in natural conversational American English. Use relaxed, varied intonation and clear diction. Keep short cues quick and clean, with no breath, intro, or long silence. Say exactly the supplied words.

cues.seated_cat_cow_prepare: Sit with both feet flat on the floor.
cues.glute_bridge_prepare: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
cues.supine_march_prepare: Lie on your back with knees bent. Alternate feet.
cues.shoulder_rolls_prepare: Relax your arms at your sides.
cues.serratus_punch_prepare: Lie on your back and reach toward the ceiling.
cues.wall_slide_prepare: Face the wall. Stay in a comfortable range.
cues.band_curl_prepare: Sit upright with your elbow near your side.
